title: A linear map is surjective exactly when its dual is injective
statement: Let $k$ be a field, $V,W$ be $k$-vector spaces, and $u:V\to W$ a $k$-linear map. The dual map $u^*:W^*\to V^*$ (dual-map notation as in [def-wf-lie-algebra-derivation]) is injective if and only if $u$ is surjective.
